items.source: Can be injected into application code and used to define a custom RestTemplateBuilder whose configuration is based upon that produced by auto-configuration.
items.translation: 可注入到应用程序代码中，用于定义一个自定义的`RestTemplateBuilder`，其配置基于自动配置所产生的结果。

items.source: Configure the specified RestTemplateBuilder.
items.translation: 配置指定的RestTemplateBuilder。

items.source: Configure the specified RestTemplateBuilder. The builder can be further tuned and default settings can be overridden.
items.translation: 配置指定的RestTemplateBuilder。该构建器可进一步调整，并可覆盖默认设置。

items.source: builder - the RestTemplateBuilder instance to configure
items.translation: builder - 用于配置的 RestTemplateBuilder 实例
